faqs.question: When should I use HTML entities?
faqs.answer: Escape &, <, >, and quotes in HTML text and attributes. Use named entities for symbols that are hard to type or might break encoding.

faqs.question: Named vs numeric entities?
faqs.answer: Named entities like © are readable. Decimal (©) and hex (©) work for any Unicode code point.

faqs.question: Need to encode or decode a string?
faqs.answer: Use HTML Entity Encode / Decode for batch conversion of arbitrary text.
